text: But I bet you I ain’t going to throw off on di’monds. Some of ’em’s worth twenty dollars apiece—there ain’t any, hardly, but’s worth six bits or a dollar.” “No! Is that so?” “Cert’nly—anybody’ll tell you so. Hain’t you ever seen one, Huck?” “Not as I remember.” “Oh, kings have slathers of them.” “Well, I don’ know no kings, Tom.” “I reckon you don’t. But if you was to go to Europe you’d see a raft of ’em hopping around.” “Do they hop?” “Hop?—your granny!
